title: Austin 1911: New City Staff, Streets & Fire Trucks
summary:
*   **Overhauled City Leadership & Staff:** Confirmed numerous city appointments, including the City Attorney, Chief of Police, department engineers, street foremen, and a large force of patrolmen, sanitary inspectors, and hospital staff, effectively re-staffing key municipal functions.
*   **Major Infrastructure Push:** Established permanent grades for several prominent streets (including East 5th, 24th, East 7th, West 6th) and mandated the construction of new sidewalks and curbing on East 8th, East 5th, and West 6th streets, giving property owners 30 days to comply or face city-managed construction.
*   **Boosted Fire Department & Public Safety:** Diverted $2,500 from a planned library site purchase, allocating $2,000 specifically for new "automobile apparatus" (likely early fire trucks) for the Fire Department and an additional $500 for general departmental expenses.
*   **Defined Hospital Staff Wages:** Fixed salaries for nurses at the City Hospital, with professional nurses earning up to $50 per month and other staff receiving set monthly wages, and authorized funds for the resident physician's horse feed.

. Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin : That the following lines be and the same are hereby established as

the correct distance according to City map on file in the General Land Office ,from an

For point "A" set a pin in the west side of Congress Avenue 6/10 foot south of this right

For point " B " set a pin in the east side of West Avenue on the right angled line.
A straight line joining these two points to be the established center line of West Fourth

This line will check within 15/100 foot the building at the S W corner of Congress Avenue
and Fourth street.It will also check very closely the biuldings at N E,S E and S w corners

Resolution directing
Sidewalks & Curbing
Certain Streets
By Councilman Powell a resolution ordering sidewalks and curbing to be built on the
following streets ,to-wit:East 8th street from Brazos to Trinity street,East 5th from
Brazos to Trinity street,East 4th from Colorado to West Avenue,on both sides of these
streets, Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : (1) That East 4th
street from Brazos to Trinity street,East 5th street from Brazos to Trinity streets,and
West 6th street from Colorado street to West Avenue,on both sides of these streets,be and
the same are hereby ordered and directed to be sidewalked and curbed,in accordance with
the general specifications heretofore adopted by the City Council,regula-ting the width of
sidewalks and the dimensions of curbing.
(2) That in default of consent within thirty days on the part of the holders of property
on said east 4th street from Brazos to Trinity street East 5th street from Brazos street
to Trinity streets,and West 6th street from Colorado street to West Avenue to sidewalk and
curb their respec-tive properties,then the Superintendent of Streets and Public Improve-
-ments be and he is hereby instructed to have said property sidewalked and curbed in
accordance with the provisions of the ordinances of the City of Austin,Texas,in such case
made and provided.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell 5 Nays none.

Taxes refunded to
Mrs Lucy Perry
699
. The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas on the 31st day of
March ,A D 1908,Mrs Lucy Perry paid to the City of Austin the sum of $ 45.25,as taxes for
the year of 1907,said taxes having been assessed against certain notes amounting to $
2,470,said notes having been executed and delivered by W T Payne to E Perry and Lucy Perry
on the 24th day of April 1906; and,

Whereas satisfactory evidence has been produced before the City Council which in its
judgement is sufficient ,to show that said E Perry and Lucy Perry became the holders and
owners of said note after January 1st,1906,and sold and assiassigned all their right
,title and interest in and to said notes before the 1st day of January,A D 1907,and on
said date were not the owners and holders of said notes;and

Whereas on account of said facts,said taxes were erroneously assessed against said E Perry
and Lucy Perryand was not a lawful tax against said parties at the time said amount was
paid by said Lucy Perry; Now therefore be it resolved by the City Council of the City of
Austin : That the sum of $ 45.25 be and the same is hereby refunded to Lucy Perry on
account of the reasons hereinabove stated,and the Mayor be and he is hereby
authorizedauthorized and instructed to cause the City Clerk to issue a warront for said
amount payable to the order of said Lucy Perry.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge ,Councilmen
Bartholomew ,Hart ,Lookridge & Powell . 5 Nays none.
